newsitem.title: UK: EMAP plans first TV acquisition - paper.
newsitem.headline: EMAP plans first TV acquisition - paper.

text.p: EMAP Plc was expected to announce an 8.0 million stg ($12.77 million) television acquisition in the coming week, the Sunday Telegraph newspaper reported.
The company's first acquisition in television will be a cable music channel, The Box, which is jointly-owned by TicketMaster and Video Jukebox Network.
The newspaper said the move was aimed at exploiting the youth market, and would be EMAP's second move into television. EMAP started Kiss TV in May, which supplies youth programming.
Neither Kiss TV nor The Box were likely to generate large advertising revenue in the short term, the report said, given the small audience figures for cable.
